files.README.md:
# mongoose-mongodb-from-mongosh

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities, repositories and services with Mongoose 8. It does not create or migrate the database.

## Settings

- Database: mongodb; code: asynchronous (every method returns a Promise).
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return DTOs (interfaces).
- Transactions: every repository write is committed at once.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/models.ts          the Mongoose models, as the database has the documents
src/database.ts        the database: DATABASE_URL, its connection and models
src/errors.ts          NotFoundError, ConflictError, ValidationFailedError: no HTTP codes
src/unit-of-work.ts    the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/entities/          one entity per table
src/repositories/      one repository per table
src/services/          one service per table
test/                  repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json     what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
npm install
npm run typecheck && npm run build
TEST_DATABASE_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017/app npm test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

/** What services take and return for the "products" table. */

/** The values of a new Product. Optional fields left out take the database's default. */
export interface ProductCreate {
  sku?: string | null
  price?: string | null
  stock?: number | null
  weight?: number | null
  big?: number | null
  created?: Date | null
  reference?: string | null
  picture?: Buffer | null
  key?: string | null
  pattern?: unknown | null
  patterns?: unknown[] | null
  text?: string | null
  parts?: { name?: string | null; inner?: { deep?: unknown | null } | null }[] | null
  low?: number | null
}

/** The values of a Product that change; fields left out keep their value. */
export interface ProductUpdate {
  sku?: string | null
  price?: string | null
  stock?: number | null
  weight?: number | null
  big?: number | null
  created?: Date | null
  reference?: string | null
  picture?: Buffer | null
  key?: string | null
  pattern?: unknown | null
  patterns?: unknown[] | null
  text?: string | null
  parts?: { name?: string | null; inner?: { deep?: unknown | null } | null }[] | null
  low?: number | null
}

/** A Product as services return it. */
export interface ProductRead {
  id: string
  sku: string | null
  price: string | null
  stock: number | null
  weight: number | null
  big: number | null
  created: Date | null
  reference: string | null
  picture: Buffer | null
  key: string | null
  pattern: unknown | null
  patterns: unknown[] | null
  text: string | null
  parts: { name?: string | null; inner?: { deep?: unknown | null } | null }[] | null
  low: number | null
}

/** A row of the "products" table, as the repositories read and write it. Its collection is a model of src/models.ts. */
export class Product {
  id!: string

  sku!: string | null

  price!: string | null

  stock!: number | null

  weight!: number | null

  big!: number | null

  created!: Date | null

  reference!: string | null

  picture!: Buffer | null

  key!: string | null

  pattern!: unknown | null

  patterns!: unknown[] | null

  text!: string | null

  parts!: { name?: string | null; inner?: { deep?: unknown | null } | null }[] | null
